description.value: You've created or been given one of the weapons of living wood or crystal wielded by the wild hunt. Your living weapon can be any common simple or martial weapon, or any other simple or martial weapon to which you have access, except it must be made of wood or crystal and gains the primal trait. Your living weapon has the effects of a shifting rune, except that it can also take the shape of a ranged weapon or an innocuous form, such as a walking stick, when activated. This rune doesn't count toward the weapon's maximum number of property runes. If your living weapon is destroyed, you can regrow it in your hands during your next daily preparations; the replacement retains any runes the weapon had before it was destroyed.
